title: VCD: A Dataset for Visual Commonsense Discovery in Images

layout.note: A large photo fills the left half; two stacked object lanes (man above, car below) fill the right half, each with a crop, a Seen group, an Unseen group and a dashed explanation box; gold elbow arrows run from the boxes in the photo to the lane crops and a dashed fan opens the last Unseen triple into the sentence.

lesson: Show a dataset's taxonomy on one real record: box the objects in the photo, pull each out with an arrow, nest the labels with curly braces and give each category one text colour, then close with a highlighted sentence that verbalises one entry.
